lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ho4V4Cr4O16 (reduced formula HoVCrO4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over eight independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral environments for all cations: Cr, V, and Ho centers each coordinate to six O neighbors, while O centers bridge one Cr, one Ho, and one V. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show corner-sharing between CrO6 and HO6 octahedra, corner-sharing between CrO6 and VO6 octahedra, and edge-sharing among like VO6 and HO6 octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites.
